lcc_original: 上帝賜福與第七日，分別爲聖，因爲在這一日、上帝歇了他在創造中所作的一切工而休息。
notes: 神→上帝: Both render H430 (Elohim); LCC systematically uses 上帝 throughout.
定為聖→分別爲聖: Both render H6942 (qadash, Piel = to sanctify/set apart as holy); WH06942+WTH8762 attach after 聖.
{<WAH0853>} remains implicit after 分別爲聖: LCC has no repeated 日 or explicit pronoun as object of the sanctification verb, so the object marker stays braced.

Major clause restructuring in second half: UNV's 他一切<WAH04480><WAH03605>{<WAH0834>}創<WH01254><WTH8804>造<WAH09001><WH06213><WTH8800>的工<WH04399> becomes LCC's 他在創造<WH01254><WTH8804>中所<WAH0834>作<WAH09001><WH06213><WTH8800>的一切<WAH04480><WAH03605>工<WH04399>. 創造 absorbs H1254 (bara=created); 所 absorbs WAH0834 (relative אֲשֶׁר, explicit in LCC so braces dropped); 作 absorbs WAH09001 (ל prefix) + H6213 (asah=make) + WTH8800; 一切 absorbs both WAH04480 (מִן prefix) and WAH03605 (כָּל=all).
歇了 in both UNV and LCC has no SN tag (free Chinese addition); H7673 (shabath=rested) and WTH8804 attach to 而休息, paralleling UNV's 安息了<WH07673><WTH8804>.
WAH09002 (ב prefix, 'in/on this [day]') attaches to the final 日 of 在這一日, matching UNV's 在這日<WAH09002>.
